Today, Apple TV published the trailer for the fifth season of Stillwater, the platform’s Peabody and Emmy Award-winning mindfulness series. Watch it below.

Stillwater returns August 21

A few days ago, Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for the fifth season of Stillwater, with all five episodes set to drop on August 21.

According to Apple TV, Stillwater’s new season will feature more “breathing exercises, mindful moments and simple everyday practices,” continuing the show’s focus on helping kids and families find their inner calm.

Stillwater originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020 and has since won a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing for a Preschool Animated Program, as well as a Peabody Award in the Children’s and Youth Programming category.
